'''Coruscant Fire and Rescue''' was the organization that provided fire fighting and rescue services to the population of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. The [[Planetary Fire Suppression Office]] ensured that buildings in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] conformed to proper fire prevention standards.
